Content Credentials are still new, so most files don't have them yet. Here are some common reasons that a file might be missing credentials:
It was created before Content Credentials existed
It was made with tools that don't support Content Credentials yet
Existing Content Credentials were stripped due to screenshotting, social media compression, re-saving, etc.
The person who created the file chose not to include them
